Section0.Title: Race Controls
Section0.Line0: Accelerate with Up, W, GamePad A, the right trigger, or D-pad up.
Section0.Line1: Brake or reverse with Down, S, GamePad B, the left trigger, or D-pad down.

Section1.Title: Steering
Section1.Line0: Steer with Left and Right, A and D, the left stick, or the D-pad.
Section1.Line1: Controller sensitivity from Options scales the analog steering response.

Section2.Title: Camera
Section2.Line0: Use Page Up and Page Down, or GamePad X and Y, to change chase distance during a race.
Section2.Line1: The chase camera now widens with speed and switches to an orbit view when the race is finished.

Section3.Title: Race Flow
Section3.Line0: Pause with Escape or GamePad Start once the countdown is over.
Section3.Line1: Finish the race to open the result panel, then return to the main menu.

Section4.Title: Menus
Section4.Line0: This front-end uses UIRoot, ScreenStack, and GameScreenManager.
Section4.Line1: No legacy RacingGame.Shared renderer is needed here.

Section5.Title: Session Flow
Section5.Line0: Splash -> Menu -> Car -> Track -> HUD is now fully wired.
Section5.Line1: The in-game HUD keeps the original MGUI layout, while pause still runs through the same screen stack.
